name: work
description: An animated, **non-interactive** three.js scene: a cartoon pelican rides a striped surfboard on rolling ocean swells — knees bending, wings flapping for balance, foam spraying off the tail — while the camera slowly orbits. Distant birds, drifting clouds, sun glare and height-tinted water round out the scene. Everything (geometry, textures, sky) is generated in code; there are no external assets.
